'''Directive 59826''', also known as '''Imperial directive 59826'''<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> was an edict invoked by the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] prior to the [[Battle of Ithor]]. It stated that if [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], who issued the edict, were to be removed from command of the joint taskforce of both the Imperial Remnant and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] around [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]], then all [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial ships]] were to immediately return to [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]]. Pellaeon issued it primarily to avoid interference by Republic [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Borsk Fey'lya]].
